World saves

Each slot stores every object's position, rotation, size and colour, plus velocity, running engines and world gravity.

A physics sandbox with 196 objects and no scoreboard.

Pick an object from the catalog and click a surface to drop it. Left-drag to grab it, then release while moving to throw. Joints, wheels and blast impulses run through Rapier on a fixed 1/60 s step, so stacks settle the same way every time.

This build

196 catalog entries across ten categories, capped at 900 rigid bodies. Geometry is instanced by shape and material; physics runs at a fixed 60 Hz with up to four substeps per frame.

Where worlds are saved

World saves live in this browser's localStorage. This build has no accounts, no server-side storage and no analytics script. Export a world to JSON if you want a copy outside the browser.
